title: From here to there / tote
slide_intent: Let everyday objects carry language with personality because repeated use can turn a slogan into a familiar phrase.
strategic_value: Large playful wording on a useful tote can extend Wise’s voice beyond transactions.
demonstration: A person carries a dark green tote with stacked pale-green words; the photograph includes the shoulder, hand and street setting.
practical_value: Compare the readability of a long phrase broken into compact lines on fabric.

content_islands.name: Tote message
content_islands.spec: Place the stacked phrase prominently on the hanging bag.

content_islands.name: Human context
content_islands.spec: Retain the body crop and hand to show how the message sits during use.
